# ADR-XXXX: Short Decision Title

**Status:** Proposed / Accepted / Superseded  
**Date:**  
**Owners:**  

## Context

What problem or constraint requires a decision? Link to the feature or user requirement.

## Options considered

List realistic alternatives and the advantages and disadvantages of each.

## Decision

State the selected approach, boundaries, and what is explicitly not included.

## Consequences

Discuss maintenance, cost, security, privacy, cultural/educational quality, performance and future flexibility.

## Review trigger

When should this decision be reconsidered? Identify measurable changes in requirements or service limits.

## References

Link to related documentation, official provider guidance and any superseded ADRs.
